channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: SpaceX, Musk pledge to donate a share each to active Trump Accounts
item.description: SpaceX said it will donate one share of the company's class A stock to every active Trump Account, and CEO Elon Musk would match it.

item.title: S&P warns Nvidia credit rating could be cut over 'rising' management and governance risk
item.description: S&P Global Ratings said Nvidia's credit rating could be cut by one notch as it flagged "rising" management and governance risk at the chipmaker.

item.title: Wealthy Europeans are looking beyond the stock market amid the AI sell-off
item.description: High-net-worth investors are looking to alternatives as turbulent markets continue to raise questions about the outlook for traditional assets.

item.title: South Korea's Kospi leads gains as tech rebound lifts Asia markets
item.description: Investors appear to have looked past a fresh set of U.S. tariffs unveiled by the White House on Wednesday, targeting more than a dozen major trading partners.

item.title: How Trump’s latest tariff moves hand India an edge over rival Asian exporters
item.description: Proposed tariffs of 18% on Bangladesh, Cambodia, Thailand, and 20% on China and Vietnam, subject to their respective trade deals, offer India a competitive advantage.

item.title: U.S. proposes new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China and the EU
item.description: The new levies seek to counter foreign trade practices deemed unfair, discriminatory or burdensome to U.S. commerce.

item.title: Vance says he was assured Jensen Huang was not under DOJ investigation
item.description: Whether the Trump administration has investigated Jensen Huang for potential national security risks has been the subject of questions.

item.title: Judge blocks FCC early-renewal process for Disney-owned ABC stations, for now
item.description: A judge has blocked the FCC's early license renewal process for Disney-owned ABC stations in 'important victory for the First Amendment'

item.title: K-beauty stocks rally as Korean brands top Amazon bestseller lists globally ahead of Black Friday
item.description: South Korean beauty stocks rose as K-beauty brands dominated Amazon's skincare rankings ahead of Black Friday.

item.title: Norse Atlantic flights suspended after warning finances 'critical'
item.description: Norse Atlantic suspended flights as it warned its financial position was "critical." The airline is seeking short-term financing and exploring a potential takeover.

item.title: Secondhand shopping is going mainstream this holiday season as consumers seek value
item.description: More consumers are shopping secondhand this holiday season as they emphasize value and uniqueness in their purchases.

item.title: ‘Your booth is waiting’: Denny’s welcomes Jensen Huang back as Nvidia CEO
item.description: Denny's reaffirmed its longstanding ties with Jensen Huang following his return as Nvidia CEO, revealing that a plaque had been restored.

item.title: Even the price of toys is on the rise. How Americans are scaling back holiday plans
item.description: U.S. consumers face higher food, travel and gift costs in 2026 as inflation and Iran-war energy shocks pressure holiday budgets.

item.title: North Korea's Kim calls for nuclear arsenal expansion, says status 'will never change'
item.description: Kim Jong Un called for wider use of tactical nuclear weapons and an expanded arsenal, rejecting international denuclearization pressure.

item.title: Inside India newsletter: Roaring economy, foreign investors’ return and now record auto sales
item.description: Automakers in India are poised to sell over 30 million vehicles in the financial year ending March 2027.

item.title: Beware higher correlation but nab high U.S. credit yields, fund managers say
item.description: The AI boom could trigger a recession, but data centers remain an attractive investment opportunity, a hedge fund manager said.

item.title: South Korea upgrades growth forecast, raises benchmark rates to highest in two years
item.description: The central bank raised rates by 25 basis points to 3.25% for its final meeting of the year, in line with expectations from economists.

item.title: Hedge funds are no longer just for the rich. They’re wooing everyday investors
item.description: Hedge funds are increasingly courting retail investors as the industry seeks new avenues for growth.

item.title: Macy's postpones Thanksgiving Day Parade due to severe weather
item.description: Macy's announced Wednesday that its annual Thanksgiving Day Parade is being postponed to Saturday due to severe weather.

item.title: Anthropic's stock has been a clunker post-IPO. Why that matters for the AI trade
item.description: Shares of Anthropic are trading below their IPO price, creating an overhang on other artificial intelligence names.

item.title: ‘Ready for any storm’: UAE minister optimistic on economy as IMF lifts forecast
item.description: The UAE is optimistic about achieving 7%-8% economic growth next year, banking on a "different" economic model.

item.title: SpaceX wins FCC approval to deploy 1 million orbital data center satellites
item.description: SpaceX won approval from the FCC to put 1 million orbital data center satellites into space, a proposal that was opposed by Amazon and other groups.

item.title: Liesman: Why Greenspan could bet on productivity — and Warsh needs to hike
item.description: Alan Greenspan famously held the line on interest rates because he believed in the productivity promise of the internet boom. Why can't Kevin Warsh do the same?

item.title: Ukraine tells Putin to ‘stop complaining’ over oil refinery attacks as Russia promises retaliation
item.description: Ukraine’s foreign minister told Putin to end the war if he wants Kyiv to stop attacking Russian refineries, after Putin said retaliation was “inevitable.”

item.title: Fed’s preferred inflation gauge accelerated to 3.8% in October, raising the 2027 stakes for the central bank
item.description: The personal consumption expenditures price index was expected to show an annual inflation rate of 3.8% in October, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

item.title: Crypto talent will return ‘when AI implodes,’ Arthur Hayes says
item.description: Maelstrom CIO Arthur Hayes expects the AI trade to face headwinds in the second half of 2027, with startup talent potentially returning to crypto afterward.

item.title: Saudi national in OpenAI bugging case is out on bond after DOJ tries to block release
item.description: Abdulrahman Alfozan, a former OpenAI engineer, is expected to be fitted with an ankle monitor, his attorney, David Rizk, previously told CNBC.

item.title: Bullish hopes spring as traders bet against a higher VIX: Options Action Live
item.description: With stocks mounting a comeback Wednesday, options trading across a few key volatility products suggests big swings in stocks may dampen in the near term.

item.title: Trump’s meddling in Huang scandal reignites voter angst over tech’s outsized political power
item.description: Nvidia’s decision to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang after pressure from Trump is intensifying bipartisan scrutiny of tech companies' ties to the administration.

item.title: We're buying more of a stock down big from its July highs
item.description: We're dipping into our large cash position as the market remains oversold.
